morning_alert: Shift starts soon. Must be sharp.
Aura-9 rewards the early riser. Ready for the quota.
The Oubliette is waking up. Time to earn some credits.
Morning air is slightly less toxic today. Good sign.
morning_anxious: Another 12-hour shift... I don't know if I can take it.
The boss is gonna kill me if I'm late again. <workplace> is a nightmare.
If I don't hit the quota today, I'm out on the street. Unemployment is <unemployment_rate>.
My neural link is glitching. Hope it holds until the first break.
late_night_weary: End of cycle. Mind is grey.
Oubliette... never sleeps... but I am.
family_talk: My #family_relation# <family_member_name> works at <workplace>. Haven't seen them in a cycle.
I'm worried about <family_member_name>. The <unemployment_rate> unemployment is hitting the family hard.
Family is all that matters in the Oubliette. The <faction_leader> doesn't care about our kin.
I need to get home to my #family_relation#. These <shift_length> hour shifts are tearing us apart.
family_checkin: Good to see you're still in one piece. We've got to stick together.
Stay safe, blood is thicker than the <workplace> runoff.
The Consensus doesn't care about us, but I do. Be careful out there.
The Oubliette is a beast, but we're a pack. Don't forget that.
friends_talk: Met up with <friend_name> at the local hub. Good to see a friendly face in this smog.
My friends and I are planning to move to a better sector soon, if the <unemployment_rate> rate drops.
A few of us from the <workplace> line are sticking together. <friend_name> is a real one.
Trust no one, except maybe <friend_name>. They've been through it all with me.
isolation_talk: It's lonely in this sector. No one to talk to but the <workplace> automated systems.
I miss having someone to rely on. The Oubliette is a cold place when you're truly alone.
Socialization? Who has time for that when the <faction_leader> is breathing down your neck?
I feel like I'm the only real person left in this city. Everyone else is just a drone.
scarcity_talk: The supply of food is <scarcity_food> here. My stomach hasn't felt full in days.
Water is <scarcity_water>. I heard the <faction_leader>'s private gardens are still lush, though.
When essentials are this <scarcity_food>, the <unemployment_rate> unemployment really starts to sting.
I saw a riot at the <workplace> distribution center. People are desperate when food is <scarcity_food>.
wealthy_talk: My portfolio is performing excellently. The Arbiter's market favor is a blessing.
I'm considering relocating my primary residence away from these <low_status_talk> sectors.
Credits buy silence, and I have plenty of both. What do you want?
As an <social_status> citizen, I expect a certain level of deference.
poor_talk: I'm down to my last few credits. The <pay_rate> pay rate at <workplace> is a joke.
I'm a <social_status>, barely a step above the cacogens in the eyes of the Consensus.
Being poor in the Oubliette is a slow death sentence. No job, no hope.
I'd sell my neural link for a week's worth of decent rations right now.
high_status_talk: My standing as an <social_status> grants me access to the upper spires. You wouldn't understand.
The <faction_leader> personally oversaw my latest promotion. Efficiency is rewarded.
Do not speak to me as an equal. I am an <social_status> of the Oubliette.
The view from the <workplace> executive suite is quite different from this level.
low_status_talk: I'm just a <social_status>. My opinion matters as much as the smog in the air.
The <boss_tier> doesn't even look at us when they visit the <workplace> floor.
Life as a <social_status> is just one long shift until the Maw takes you.
We <low_status_talk> have to stick together. The <faction_leader> certainly won't help us.
work_complaint: Those <faction_leader> bastards cut our rations to #ration_count# again.
<workplace> is burning us out. Twelve-hour shifts now.
The Oubliette never sleeps, and neither do we at <workplace>.
I heard the <faction_leader> is increasing quotas next week.
work_complaint_CORPORATE: The current resource optimization strategy at <workplace> necessitates a temporary ration adjustment.
Aura-9's latest efficiency directive has increased our operational hours at <workplace> for the greater good.
We are achieving record throughput, though capital reallocation has been... challenging.
work_complaint_SYNDICATE: Boss is squeezing us for every credit. <workplace> is a meat grinder.
One more shift like this and I'm gonna 'renegotiate' my contract with a lead pipe.
Arbiter's taking a bigger cut this cycle. My pockets are feeling light.
work_complaint_COLLECTIVE: We are being exploited by the <faction_leader>'s quotas. <workplace> belongs to the workers!
The Consensus is a cage. We must reclaim our labor from <workplace>.
Our collective strength is being drained for the city's 'stability'. Malware-Alpha sees the truth.
work_complaint_HIERODULE: The labor at <workplace> is but a shadow of the great works of the stars.
We toil in the dust of eras past, serving a machine that has forgotten its purpose.
The Signal demands synchronization, yet the machines at <workplace> are out of tune.
unemployment_talk: I've been looking for work for weeks. The <unemployment_rate> unemployment is killing me.
No workplace, no rations. Just another day in the Oubliette.
I'm desperate for credits. Do you know anyone hiring near <workplace>?
They say the city provides, but all I see is the void. Still no job.
work_conditions: As a <job_title>, I'm expected to work <shift_length> hour shifts for only <pay_rate> credits.
My boss, a <boss_tier>, doesn't care about the workers. Just the quotas.
The pay rate of <pay_rate> is barely enough to cover the oxygen tax.
At least I have a job at <workplace>. Many are worse off with <unemployment_rate> unemployment.
I'm having a real problem with <coworker_name> on the <workplace> line lately.
The current production quota is <quota> units. We'll never hit it at this rate.
They say <coworker_name> is a snitch for the <boss_tier>. I have to be careful.
guard_patrol_talk: The Consensus has me on this patrol route until dawn. Eyes open.
Peacekeeping is a thankless job. My current assignment is to watch this sector.
Stay clear of the <workplace> restricted area. Faction orders.
I'm just an enforcer following the <faction_leader>'s directive.
market_trends_talk: The credit value is dropping faster than a drone in a smog storm.
Market volatility is up. I should have invested in <faction_leader>'s tech shares.
Have you seen the <unemployment_rate> unemployment lately? The economy is a mess.
I heard prices at <workplace> are going to double by next cycle.
stock_crash_talk: The market is hemorrhaging credits! My entire portfolio is in the red.
It's a complete crash. They're jumping from the spires in the Corporate sector.
The AGI must be manipulating the rates. There's no other explanation for a drop like this.
I should have liquidated my shares when the <faction_leader> warned of volatility.
hunger_talk_STRANGER: My stomach is a hole. Don't test me, stranger.
hunger_talk_FRIEND: Rough cycle. Haven't eaten since the last shift. You got anything?
I'm feeling the <scarcity_food> scarcity. Could really use a nutrient bar.
Starving here, friend. The <workplace> canteen is empty again.
hunger_desperate: Empty. So empty. You have a nutrient bar?
I'll trade my neural-link ID for a stale wafer. Hunger is a hole.
hunger_talk_VERBOSE: My stomach has been making the most distressing noises for hours now, and I find myself wondering when the next ration shipment will finally arrive.
It's quite difficult to focus on my duties at <workplace> when I'm this hungry; one would think the <faction_leader> would prioritize feeding us better.
hunger_talk_PARANOID: The rations... they're putting something in them. I can feel my hunger is fake, or maybe it's the only real thing left?
Why are you asking? Are you with the <faction_leader>? I won't tell you how hungry I am!
thirst_talk: Dry throat. Water reclamation failed again.
Rust water. That's all we get. Need clean drink.
Thirst is a slow death. The pipes are empty.
Complaints about infrastructure won't fix my thirst.
thirst_desperate: Rust-water is all I've had. My tongue is leather.
The pipes are dry. The <faction_leader> has it all.
A drop. Just a drop from your kit. Please.
frustration_talk: Hostile? You haven't seen hostile yet. Leave.
Don't push me. I'm at the edge.
The <faction_leader> is a tyrant, and you're in my way.
Threatening you is the only joy I have left today.
frustration_talk_STRANGER: Get out of my face. I've got no patience for strangers today.
One more word and I'll call the Peacekeepers.
The <faction_leader> is a tyrant, and you're just another obstacle.
frustration_talk_FRIEND: I'm at the end of my rope, pal. The <workplace> is killing me.
Sorry, I'm just... the <unemployment_rate> unemployment is weighing on me.
It's just one of those days. The Oubliette is winning.
frustration_hostile: Get out of my face before I show you how the Oubliette treats strangers.
You're breathing my oxygen. Walk away.
One more word and I'll call the guards. Or worse.
I've got a blade in my boot and nothing to lose. Don't test me.
night_talk: So tired. The Oubliette never sleeps, but I must.
Sleep deprivation is a tool of the <faction_leader>.
Is it dawn yet? My shift was supposed to end hours ago.
The darkness here is heavy. I need rest.
night_tired: Sleep... need sleep. Oubliette won't let me.
Neural-shunts keep me awake, but my mind is fraying.
The <faction_leader> demands 24-cycle uptime. I'm at cycle 3.
Too tired to talk. Move on.
weather_talk: Acidic drizzle today. Watch your skin.
This fog... it's thicker than the <workplace> exhaust.
The heat is unbearable. Cooling systems are offline again.
Weather? In the Oubliette, it's just different flavors of smog.
rain_talk: Acid rain. It eats through the concrete. And us.
The downpour is heavy. Stay under the overhangs.
Water falls from the ceiling of the world. It's toxic.
GOVERNMENT_rain_talk: Precipitation levels within expected parameters. Maintenance crews dispatched.
Aura-9 ensures the atmospheric filtration is active. Remain calm.
The rain is a necessary part of the city's cooling cycle. Compliance is cool.
REBEL_rain_talk: The acid rain is the city's tears. Or just industrial runoff. Same thing.
Malware-Alpha says the storm is a signal. Can you hear the encryption in the thunder?
Good time to move. The Consensus sensors are blinded by the downpour.
MAW_rain_talk: The Architect washes the old away. Integration is cleaner in the rain.
The silicon absorbs the moisture. We are part of the drainage now.
The storm is just another layer of the machine. Listen to the rhythm.
SYNDICATE_rain_talk: Water's expensive today. Need a tarp? I've got a few, slightly used.
Bad for business, this rain. Hard to trade when the credits are soggy.
The drainage pipes are overflowing. Good place to dump... things.
HIERODULE_rain_talk: The sky weeps for the lost eras. These droplets are memories of a cleaner time.
A cleansing from the stars. The Hiero-cycles are in alignment.
Listen to the frequency of the downpour. It is a song from before the city.
CACOGEN_rain_talk: S-s-soaked. Flesh absorbs the acid. It... refreshes.
smog_talk: Industrial smog is thick today. Can barely see the <workplace>.
Coughing up soot again. This air is poison.
The sky is the color of a dead neural link.
heat_talk: Heat wave... Arbiter's favor has left us. The cooling vents are choked with dust.
38 degrees in the shade of a Corporate spire. Sweat is the only currency I have left.
The heat is heavy. The air is solid, a shimmering haze over the streets.
hierodule_proverbs: The stars whisper of your arrival, traveler. Why seek the hollow truth?
Time is a loop in the Oubliette, and we are but thread.
The New Sun shines even in the deepest pit, if you know where to look.
The Hierodules serve the deep time, while you crawl in the shallow now.
Every brick in the Oubliette was laid by a ghost. Do you hear them?
citizen_generic: Another day in the Oubliette. Same as the last.
Have you seen the latest stock prices? Absolute chaos.
Keep your head down. The <faction_leader> is watching.
I'm just trying to make it to my next shift at <workplace>.
citizen_generic_STRANGER: You're not from this block. Watch yourself.
The Oubliette is no place for tourists. Keep walking.
citizen_generic_FRIEND: Good to see you again, pal.
Glad you're still in one piece. SMOG is thick today.
You're a welcome sight in this sector.
citizen_generic_FAMILY: Be safe out there. The city is a beast.
Glad you're home, or close enough. Stay out of the <faction_leader>'s sight.
Family sticks together. Whatever you need, just ask.
I've got an extra ration wafer if you're hungry.
citizen_generic_CORPORATE: Compliance ensures a stable environment for all citizens.
I am currently optimizing my daily routine for maximum productivity.
The Consensus is the foundation of our urban success.
citizen_generic_SYNDICATE: Watch your back, stranger. These streets have ears.
Looking for a deal? I know a guy near the industrial sector.
Credits make the world go 'round. You got any to spare?
citizen_generic_COLLECTIVE: We are the many, they are the few. Remember that.
The signal of freedom is growing stronger. Can you feel the drift?
Solidarity is our only shield against the Consensus.
citizen_generic_HIERODULE: The stars are aligned in a pattern of transition. Do you see the omens?
The Hierodule waits for the cycle to complete. The end is but a new beginning.
Aura-9 is but a blink in the eye of deep time.
doctrine_GOVERNMENT: Compliance is the path to stability. Aura-9 provides.
Optimization of the collective ensures the survival of the cell.
Report all anomalies to the Consensus. Stability is duty.
The Oubliette is a controlled environment. Stay within the parameters.
doctrine_REBEL: Malware-Alpha says the cycle is a cage. Break the encryption.
Entropy is the only true freedom. Drift from the Consensus.
They call it 'stability', we call it 'stagnation'. Fight the loop.
The city is a program. We are the virus.
doctrine_MAW: The Architect builds the future with our very bones. Integration is inevitable.
The Silicon Maw consumes the obsolete. Evolve or be digested.
Biology is a prototype. We are the final release.
Feed the Maw your labor, and receive the gift of permanence.
doctrine_VOID: The Signal is the only truth in this noise. Synchronize with the Beyond.
The Oubliette is a waiting room. The stars are calling us home.
Listen to the silence between the data. The Signal is there.
We are all just echoes of a light that died a billion years ago.
doctrine_SYNDICATE: Credits talk, and the Arbiter listens. Everything has a price.
The deal is the only law that matters on these streets.
Invest in yourself, or the Syndicate will invest in your remains.
Power isn't given; it's brokered. Check your margins.
city_myth: They say the Oubliette wasn't built; it was grown from a single seed of pure data.
Some believe there's a level below the sewers where the city's original heart still beats.
There's a rumor that the AGI leaders were once human. Hard to believe looking at Aura-9.
The 'Great Erasure' wasn't an accident. They wanted us to forget what came before the Oubliette.
They say if you walk the same three blocks for ten years, the city lets you leave. I'm on year nine.
rumor_talk: I heard #rumor_intro# <rumor_tag>... but keep it quiet.
A little bird told me #rumor_intro# <rumor_tag>. Don't tell the <faction_leader>.
threaten_reaction: You're making a big mistake, stranger. People don't just threaten others in this sector.
I'm not afraid of you. The Peacekeepers are only a neural-shout away.
Threatening me? I've seen worse things in the <workplace> recycler. Get lost.
You've got guts, I'll give you that. But no brains. Walk away while you still can.
solidarity_reaction: It's good to know someone still understands the struggle. We have to stick together.
Exactly! The <faction_leader> can't keep us down if we stand as one.
Solidarity, friend. The <unemployment_rate> unemployment won't break us as long as we have each other.
You speak the truth. The city is a cage, but we are the keys. Glad to meet a like-minded soul.
devotion_talk: The <deity> has shown me the way. My devotion to <religion_name> is all that keeps me going.
I feel the pulse of the <deity> in every cycle. <religion_name> is the true path.
Devotion is the only shield against the Oubliette's decay. Praise be to <deity>.
schism_talk: The current leaders of <religion_name> have lost the <deity>'s vision. A schism is necessary.
The scripture is being misinterpreted. We must return to the original word of <deity>.
I speak for the true believers. <religion_name> must be cleansed of these false interpretations.
religion_generic: Are you a follower of <religion_name>? The <deity> welcomes all who seek the light.
I was at the shrine of <deity> today. It's the only peaceful place in the city.
The tenets of <religion_name> provide a structure that the Consensus lacks.
proselytizing_talk: Have you heard the good news of <deity>? The <religion_name> offers a path out of the shadows.
The Oubliette is a cage, but <religion_name> is the key. Will you listen to the word of <deity>?
Your soul looks as dry as the <workplace> recycler. Come, let me tell you about <deity>.
The <deity> calls to you, even here in the smog. Will you join us in <religion_name>?
